opportunities.title: Python Backend Django Developer
opportunities.description: BidWise Labs is hiring a Python Backend Django Developer to build and maintain REST APIs, background jobs, and PostgreSQL data pipelines. You will work with product and frontend teams, write clean tested code, review pull requests, improve performance, and help deploy secure services used by real customers in Tunisia.

opportunities.title: Community Growth Partner
opportunities.description: We are launching a fast-growing community sales network and looking for a Community Growth Partner. The mission mixes client outreach, onboarding new partners, and helping them build their own local teams. Compensation includes direct commissions on personal sales and recurring bonuses linked to the performance of the members you recruit and coach inside your network.

opportunities.title: Remote Data Entry Agent - Immediate Start
opportunities.description: Work from home and earn quickly by processing simple forms for international clients. No previous experience is required and acceptance is guaranteed after payment of a registration and onboarding fee. Selected candidates must send the training fee before starting in order to receive access credentials and the starter package.

opportunities.title: Data Analyst Internship
opportunities.description: BidWise Analytics offers a structured internship for students who want to work on dashboards, SQL queries, and market intelligence reports. The intern will clean datasets, support KPI monitoring, prepare Power BI views, and present weekly insights with the supervision of a senior data analyst.

opportunities.title: Seasonal Customer Support Agent - Summer 2026
opportunities.description: A tourism services company is hiring seasonal customer support agents for the summer period. The role includes handling phone calls, assisting travelers, following booking issues, and coordinating with the operations team during the peak holiday season.

opportunities.title: Acquisition d'equipements informatiques pour laboratoires universitaires
opportunities.description: Consultation pour l'acquisition et la fourniture d'equipements informatiques, postes de travail, ecrans et accessoires reseau au profit de laboratoires universitaires. Le marche comprend la livraison, l'installation, les tests de bon fonctionnement et la garantie initiale sur site.
